O Jerusalem; give praise to your God

saying
Have no fear; I am the first and the last and the Living one;
然而，有一件事我要责备你，

But I have this against you
that you tolerate your woman
Jezebel

But I have this against you
that you let the woman Jezebel say she is a prophet and give false teaching
making my servants go after the desires of the flesh and take food offered to false gods.

neither thirsty any more; neither will the sun beat on them
nor any heat;

审判死人的时候也到了。你的仆人众先知和众圣徒，
凡敬畏你名的人，连大带小得赏赐的时候也到了。你败坏那些败坏世界之人的时候也就到了。
